name: Osei & Park Jacquard Silk-Analog Tie
description: A slim four-inch tie in deep burgundy jacquard with a repeating geometric pattern that blends Akan adinkra symbols with circuit-trace motifs — subtle enough to read as abstract at a distance. Constructed from Osei & Park's signature silk-analog that resists staining and holds a dimple crease through an eight-hour meeting day. The back loop is stamped with the maker's mark in gold.
functionality: Stain-resistant fabric treatment, crease-retention interlining, NFC tag in keeper loop for authentication.
what_it_says: You have opinions about neckwear and you are not embarrassed about this.
story_hooks: The NFC authentication tag in the keeper loop has been cloned and sold on the secondary market — counterfeit versions are flooding Circuit-level offices.
A negotiator wore this tie to every deal she closed for four years; it's become a superstition she can't shake.

physical_description.visual_profile: A slim, refined neckwear piece that reads as understated luxury. The tie drapes with elegant fluidity, its narrow four-inch width creating a sharp, contemporary silhouette against the torso. At distance, the pattern appears as abstract geometric weaving; up close, it reveals a deliberate fusion of Akan adinkra wisdom symbols interlocked with delicate circuit-trace pathways—a visual statement bridging heritage and neural-age aesthetics.
physical_description.fit: Slim four-inch cut, designed for precision knots and modern tailoring. Sits flush against the body without bulk, complementing both fitted shirts and slightly oversized corp wear. The length allows for traditional tie knots with controlled proportions.
physical_description.primary_material: Osei & Park silk-analog—a proprietary synthetic that mimics mulberry silk's luster and drape while offering superior stain resistance and structural retention. Designed to withstand corpo environment wear.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, lustrous surface with subtle jacquard weave texture visible at close inspection. The fabric holds a crisp dimple crease in the center fold without mechanical intervention. Feels cool and fluid against skin, with a slight grip that prevents slipping.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep burgundy base (near maroon) with gold and charcoal geometric patterning. The adinkra-circuit motifs create a tonal contrast—gold highlights traditional symbols, charcoal emphasizes the technological overlays.
physical_description.closures: Traditional slip tie construction with concealed metal keeper bar at back loop. No magnetic or friction fasteners—purely mechanical, timeless elegance.
distinctive_features: Repeating jacquard pattern blending Akan adinkra symbols with circuit-trace motifs
Gold-stamped maker's mark on back loop interior
Holds professional dimple crease through extended wear
Subtle color graduation in the jacquard that shifts between burgundy tones under light
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. The price point and artisanal heritage mark this as high-end corpo or old-money wear. Osei & Park is a boutique Tier 1 manufacturer.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by individuals who signal both corporate professionalism and diasporic pride. The adinkra-circuit fusion appeals to second and third-generation GLMZ professionals with pan-African heritage who reject monolithic corpo aesthetics. A statement piece for board-adjacent roles, legal counsel, or cultural liaison positions.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops a subtle lived-in character with repeated wear. The dimple crease remains sharp through regular use. Quality construction resists fraying or pattern degradation over years of wear.
